complementarity: h12 curvature modulation E|d_j H_ii| recovers all five CR3 planes where pure UX-Hessian profile JD fails, but fails alpha-gamma where JD succeeds. C1-C3 modulation is zero and JD identifies the axes. Unlike self curvature itself, this component ignores constant-in-U quadratic bias. h09/h11 show decoder failure of the prior self-curvature combination, motivating this change.
weight_rule: Using only the eight single-loss analytic runs at the same Q and seed, the common sufficient weight interval against every plane grid rotation beyond six degrees is [81.8175501680,98.4932302783]. Its geometric midpoint is 89.769, rounded to fixed 90 for every dataset. No arbitrary weight grid and no decoder T selection. Confirm full-space G1 before inference.
